title: Absolute Extrema on a Closed Triangular Region
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the absolute maximum of f(x, y) = 2 + 2x + 2y - x^2 - y^2 on the closed triangular region bounded by x = 0, y = 0, and y = 9 - x.

steps.title: Find Interior Critical Points
steps.explanation: The point (1, 1) lies strictly inside the triangle because 1 + 1 = 2 < 9.

steps.title: Evaluate at Interior Critical Point
steps.explanation: Compute function value at interior peak.

steps.title: Inspect Boundary Behavior
steps.mathExpression: \text{On } x = 0: g(y) = 2 + 2y - y^2 \le 3; \quad \text{On } y = 0: h(x) \le 3; \quad \text{On } x+y=9: f < 0
steps.explanation: All boundary values are strictly less than 4.
